fact: After a recertification operation the Registre national unique (RNU), which identifies PNBSF beneficiaries through scoring, holds 1,000,649 households in 2026 and the 2026 programme targets 469,497 households, with duplicates removed with ANSD.
title: Bourses familiales : le RNU compte 1 000 649 ménages après la recertification
